$comment: Console copy rules enforced by `lab console review` on visible primary text. docs/engineering.md links here; this file is the maintained list. Patterns are JavaScript regular expressions matched case-insensitively unless flags say otherwise.

patterns.name: raw camelCase identifier
patterns.$comment: Type names such as nativePackage. Dotted configuration paths (releaseRepository.directory) are values an operator types and stay allowed.

patterns.name: GMT offset instead of time zone name (use Timestamp)
numeric date instead of console date format (use Timestamp)
raw validation or encoder text (use lib/validation describeViolation)

identifiers.$comment: Code identifiers in primary text (deviceId, osUpdatePolicy, DeviceGroup). Matched case-sensitively on whole tokens: a token joined to others by '-', '.', '/', ':', '@' or '_' is a technical value (perl-DBD-MySQL, NetworkManager-wifi) and is not matched. Inventory values such as package names render as a lone text node; a lone token is therefore checked only inside copy positions (singleTokenScope), while any phrase containing whitespace and every placeholder, aria-label and title is checked. allow lists product and brand names written in camel case.

rawByteValue.$comment: docs/design.md Numbers and units: a bare number of four or more digits is a raw byte count when its label, row or column header names bytes. Exact counts belong in Details.
rawByteValue.label: \bbytes?\b

freeformInput.$comment: docs/engineering.md Free-text inputs. Shared by the lindm/freeform-input ESLint rule (web/eslint/freeform-input.mjs) and the ui-review freeform probe. A text-like input must declare data-freeform="<why the value is genuinely new>". domainLabel is matched against a normalized label (lowercase; parentheticals, 'optional'/'required' and punctuation removed); a match means the input names something that already exists and must be a SearchPicker or SelectField. Inventory domains also match with a name/ID/prefix/version suffix ('Package name'); console-creatable domains match only as the bare noun ('Group', not the new-record 'Group name'). Search boxes (type=search or a label starting with 'Search') are exempt from domainLabel only.
freeformInput.domainLabel: ^(?:(?:filter|limit) by |by |select |choose |pick |target |existing |assigned )?(?:an? |the )?(?:(?:package managers?|packages?|operating systems?|os|os versions?|os names?|architectures?|arch|status(?:es)?|kinds?|event types?|audit actions?|hostnames?|hosts?|devices?|machines?|services?|service units?|systemd units?|advisor(?:y|ies)|cves?|cve ids?|actors?|actor accounts?|file paths?|inventory paths?)(?: names?| ids?| prefix(?:es)?| versions?| filters?)?|(?:groups?|device groups?|account groups?|roles?|profiles?|rollouts?|tags?|labels?|accounts?|users?)(?: prefix(?:es)?| filters?)?)$
